facts.label: city served
facts.value: Served — one of the 24 South Carolina towns confirmed served (Brand Guide Section E)

facts.label: local context
facts.value: In the 2020 census 21.2% of Walterboro residents were 65+ (17.9% in 2010); 2,689 housing units (2020) and historic homes dating back to 1820; mean July high about 90.5 F and about 51.4 inches of precipitation a year.

facts.label: neighborhoods
facts.value: Catholic Hill (rural area, southern Walterboro, once Thompson's Crossroads); Hickory Valley (original settlement site)

facts.label: place entities
facts.value: HCA Healthcare Colleton Hospital (Walterboro); Colleton County Courthouse (Robert Mills design); University of South Carolina Salkehatchie; Lowcountry Regional Airport

facts.label: permit office
facts.value: City of Walterboro posts its own Building Permit Application (walterborosc.org); Colleton County Planning and Development (31 Klein St, Walterboro; 843-549-1709) is the county office. Official pages do not state which office issues inside city limits - confirm
